scenario: Case-insensitive `/i` flag at runtime per LREG.5.2 — `/HELLO/i` matches `hello`, `HELLO`, `Hello`. Pin: two User facts — `hello` (matches) and `world` (doesn't). Only one rule_fire_begin.
rules_ds:
schema User scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    name: String mutable

rule greet:
    User u where u.name ~ /^hello$/i
->
    log info "matched"
